children: Ryanair's shares will likely stay muted unless jet fuel prices come down or wider industry capacity cuts are seen in short-haul flights, J.P. Morgan analysts say in a note. But the analysts point to some bright spots. The airline has seen an uptick in pricing, a positive signal, they say. Ryanair's move to lower capacity in off-peak winter periods could also bode well, which the company expects the broader industry to do too, the analysts add. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
